description: Reveal moving procedural specimens with an inertial circular scanner, then intercept only the requested silhouettes with delayed localization pulses.
name: Reveal to Identify V2 · Difficulty 4 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Start the survey and fully illuminate every shell to optically certify all numbered plates. Then tag only the requested silhouettes. Grab and drag the crosshair; SPACE emits a pulse. The numbered contact sheet retains exposed pixels and shows full glyphs after optical certification. Pulses arm only when every plate is certified. The displayed calibration and valve-switch record stay visible; removing a wanted load changes the flow, so observe its new state before the next intercept. White arrows show velocity; blue arrows show the changing current. The pulse hits the fixed emission point after its displayed travel time while the specimens keep moving. A miss, protected tag, or incomplete certification ends the episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to unrelated, blank, browser-settings or non-task tabs.
